text: Founders often experience, food, financial and housing insecurity while founding the grassroots initiatives that serve their community. It is challenging to find and win grants that cover for the operational and founding teams of non-profits: therefore, community members are forced to operate the organization on a volunteer basis for years. Most grants that are categorized as operational, cover the expenses of consultants, co-creators and other experts in the field, but not the founders or the operational team. Few grants support founders with legal advice, or grant-writing support, or other capacity building for the team members themselves. There is an overreliance on non-profit system were these basic expenses are not even covered Most organizations that already have a high capacity are the ones receiving the funding.
